description: This file contains Makefile macros and definitions for building and managing root filesystem images, including conditional compilation for MKLIBS, package management commands, and root filesystem preparation scripts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Builds a list of executable and shared object files, then uses mklibs to create stripped shared libraries for the target root filesystem.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines the command for package management using opkg with specific options.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes unnecessary files and resets package info for a clean package state.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem by copying files, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning up version control directories, and invoking mklibs and clean_ipkg.
